records.reason: Daily-prep disguise of item auras; resolved by an opposing Perception check vs your Deception DC — no statistic on your sheet changes.
Pure flavour: how far your voice carries; no rollable or derived statistic.
Modifies the Scrounger downtime Craft activity (item level cap, who takes the shoddy penalty); the app does not model temporary-item crafting.

Every melee weapon you wield gains the versatile B trait (a real change to your Strikes' damage options), and no field can add a trait to wielded weapons — the strikes engine reads traits off the item record only.

A 2-action Strike activity whose extra void damage lands on the target and nearby enemies; the 'once per 10 minutes' frequency is not expressible by limitedUses (day|hour|minute|round|turn) and per:'minute' would over-grant.
Grants an activity (Stride/Step, Strike, Sneak) resolved at the table; no sheet statistic changes.
Body-pouch storage flavour; the clumsy 1 is self-imposed only while you choose to carry a non-precious item and is applied via the conditions tracker.

Grants the critical specialization effect with the polearm, spear, and sword weapon groups — exactly the critSpec/critSpecWeapons lane (cf. garudas-squall groups:['bow']), and the record carries neither field.
Speeds up the Gather Information exploration activity and softens a critical failure at master; the app models neither exploration timing nor degrees of success.
Adds conditions to the Treat Condition Medicine activity's list; the activity is resolved at the table and the app does not model its condition list.
A 2-action ability that creates light and can dazzle evil creatures in the area — the entire effect falls on enemies; it is not a focus spell (no focus/spell traits) so focusSpells would be wrong.
An action that ignores the target's concealment and cover for one Strike; a per-attack table adjudication, not a sheet statistic.
Grants a rope-swing activity ending in an Athletics Grapple; movement and a check resolved at the table.
A free action to Stand when you stop being unconscious; no statistic changes.
A Stride variant (Speed − 10 ft, hopping over intervening squares) resolved on the battle map; not a Speed change to the sheet.
An attack against the target's Reflex DC; all outcomes (no reactions, off-guard, −2 Reflex) are imposed on the target.

'You learn the House of Imaginary Walls composition cantrip' — the spell exists in core.json (rank 0) and every sibling bard composition feat (dirge-of-doom, allegro, triple-time…) carries focusSpells; this one carries nothing, so the cantrip never reaches the Spells page.

Your eidolon becomes Large with 10-foot reach; the eidolon block never learns this. The companion-mod registry has no size/reach field, but it takes note-only entries (cf. 'stealthy-companion'), so the grant can be surfaced on the eidolon card.

companionMod.note: Hulking Size: your eidolon is Large instead of its previous size and its reach increases to 10 feet. No other statistics change.

records.reason: Temporary HP triggered mid-combat by inflicting persistent bleed with jaws; a one-off event the player enters in the HP control, not a static sheet value.
An activity making two Strikes with the normal multiple attack penalty; nothing on the sheet changes.
A downtime safe house granting Veil of Privacy-like protection to a location; the app models neither downtime structures nor location wards.
A reaction Strike with a possible disrupt and Step; resolved at the table.

The imbued ikon's immanence gives your weapon the thrown 15 ft trait (or +10 ft thrown range) — a real change to that weapon's Strikes. No field adds a trait to a weapon, and ikon imbue/immanence state is unmodelled (only mated-birds-in-paired-flight has any ikon field).
An activity (throw, Stride, draw); the off-guard rider while Raging is imposed on the enemy.
Describes what you retain when you Change Shape (speech, unarmed attacks, tail); the underlying kitsune unarmed attacks already come from the heritage/ancestry, and the form itself is descriptive.
Lets your anadi Change Shape into a bipedal hybrid that keeps spider-form benefits plus manipulate actions; no new statistic — the spider form's own grants are unchanged.
A death-and-return narrative resolved entirely by the GM (returning at 1 HP or full HP when someone picks up your weapon, or fusing into an intelligent item).
An impulse that creates a stone object on the map; terrain creation the app does not model.
A reaction that downgrades a critical hit on a successful check; resolved at the table when it triggers.
An action that chains finishers via panache; entirely an at-the-table action-economy ability.
Changes what your Harm spell does to an undead target (Will save, stupefied); every effect is on the target.
Adds a trigger to Reactive Strike (an ally being Struck); the reaction and its trigger are adjudicated at the table.

'When in Ursine Avenger Form, you gain fast healing 5' — the form exists as a stance record (stances/ursine-avenger-form, with strikes and a conditional-sense field), but there is no fast-healing/regeneration field on stances, modes, or feats, so the benefit is invisible.
Mythic capstone: creature traits, ageless immortality, mount-side protections, and soul gems — GM-adjudicated death handling plus effects on your mount and on dying creatures around you.
A finisher that compares one attack roll against two foes' ACs; resolved at the table.
A Strike activity; grabbed and persistent bleed are imposed on the target.
Upgrades a Crafting success to a critical success for your Specialty Crafting type; the app models neither the Craft activity nor degree-of-success upgrades.
An impulse creating a fog area (concealment and difficult terrain) on the map; battlefield effect, not a sheet statistic.
During daily preparations you create a variant energy breath potion; the player adds the consumable to inventory, and the potion's own DC note is table-side.
A 2-action movement ability to squeeze through a wall or floor; map movement with GM-judged material restrictions.
'Five times per day, you can use Prescient Planner to pull out a common consumable item up to 6 levels lower than your level' — a bounded daily resource with no use tracker on the sheet.
Same five-per-day Prescient Planner resource as the investigator version; nothing tracks the uses.

'You gain your implement's initiate benefit.' Thaumaturge Dedication already records the pick (choice flag dedicationImplement), and the benefits exist as classFeatures `initiate-benefit-<implement>`, but build.ts only pushes them inside `if (ownsClass('thaumaturge'))` (build.ts ~3043), so an archetype character gets nothing. No data field points a feat at a classFeature.
A 3-action activity striking every enemy within 30 feet; action-economy and attack resolution at the table.
A 1-action ability that replaces damage rolls with average damage until end of turn; a rolling convention applied at the table.

The mount from Faithful Steed becomes a nimble or savage animal companion — the maturity ladder the companion-mod registry exists for (cf. battle-hardened-companion) — and there is no COMPANION_MODS entry, so the companion never advances.

companionMod.note: Imposing Destrier: the mount you gained with Faithful Steed is at least a nimble or savage animal companion — pick savage in Edit if you want that side. During an encounter, even without Command an Animal, it can use 1 action on your turn to Stride or Strike (that is all the actions it gets that round).

records.reason: A 3-action activity making six Strikes at fixed multiple attack penalties; nothing on the sheet changes.
Adds a trigger to Opportune Riposte and changes the damage type of that one deflected Strike; a reaction resolved at the table.
Lets you choose full sneak attack damage in place of the Sly Striker damage against a non-off-guard target; a per-Strike choice made when rolling damage.
A fortune reaction forcing a reroll; resolved at the table when it triggers.
A 3-action volley activity against every enemy in an area; attack resolution only.
A reaction on landing from a fall: reduces the fall distance, creates difficult terrain, and damages nearby creatures — terrain and target effects.
The mount gained through Cavalier Dedication becomes a mature animal companion (plus the 1-action independence rider); COMPANION_MODS has no entry for it, so the companion stays young.

companionMod.note: Impressive Mount: the mount you gained through Cavalier Dedication is at least a mature animal companion. During an encounter, even without Command an Animal, it can use 1 action on your turn to Strike or Stride (or Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has that Speed) — that is all the actions it gets that round.

records.reason: Substitutes Performance for Diplomacy on Make an Impression and widens the audience after a long performance; a social activity with no skill-substitution lane and no modifier change.
Improves how long a mindless undead stays your minion after its save; entirely target-side.
Improves the minion duration on the undead you Command; entirely target-side.
Redirects the Hit Points you would regain from Communal Healing to an ally; changes only an ally's HP.
Loosens Dueling Riposte's requirement and grants an extra reaction usable only for it; reactions are tracked at the table, not on the sheet.

'The damage of your elemental blast increases by one die' (repeatable; maxTakable 3). deriveBlastStrikes (derive.ts ~1495) computes dice purely from character level — `1 + [5,9,13,17]` — so an archetype kineticist's blast ignores this feat entirely; no field expresses a damage-die count.

Elemental Bulwark is a REACTION granting resistance 5 against the one triggering damage instance; this raises it to 10. An unconditional resistances field would over-grant permanent resistance, and there is no per-reaction resistance lane.
